verdict.rationale: GitBook explicitly lists 'Preview deployments' as a shipped feature alongside GitHub/GitLab sync and a change-request workflow for reviewing docs changes before they go live, matching the PR-preview-before-merge story for docs-as-code teams. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that previews are auto-generated per PR with a shareable link, and more detail on how previews tie into the GitHub PR UI itself.
